meta.notes: A pig variant: asset_id is the grown pig's texture (64 by 64 pixels) and baby_asset_id the piglet's (32 by 32), under textures/entity/pig/. Its spawn condition picks cherry groves with priority 1, above the everywhere variant. An optional model chooses the vanilla cold or warm body shape. Try /summon minecraft:pig ~ ~ ~ {variant:"msm_examples:blossom_pig"}.
